title: design-synthesis.v1
description: S055 §5.1 — DRAFT synthesis emitted by the design-tournament `converge` synthesis stage. The script computes `disagreement_matrix` as a PURE FUNCTION of the verdict objects (the synthesis agent can never launder a disagreement away); the script may ADD to `unresolved[]`, never remove. Owner: forge. Consumed by forge inline (presents section-by-section; the converge DECISION stays with forge/user).

disagreement_matrix.description: Script-computed; one row per (challenger, approach) disagreement.

status.description: INCOMPLETE when the budget floor (>=2 approaches + 1 challenger + synthesis) was not met — looks unfinished, not polished.
